title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description_text:
Key Responsibilities

 

Full Stack Engineer (React + Python + AWS)

Experience Level:  4-7 years 

Location : Pune, Bangalore, Hyderabad or Chennai

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and enhance application dashboard features using React and TypeScript.
  • Build and maintain backend APIs using Python (FastAPI).
  • Integrate frontend UI with backend services and AWS-based data systems.
  • Develop serverless and container-based applications on AWS.
  • Optimize UI and API performance for handling large datasets and reporting needs.
  • Debug and troubleshoot application issues using CloudWatch logs.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define requirements and deliver production-quality software

Skills and Experience:

  • 4-7 years
  • Strong experience in React (TypeScript) and modern UI development principles.
  • Professional experience in Python backend development (FastAPI or similar frameworks).
  • Hands-on experience with AWS application development, including:
    • AWS Lambda
    • API Gateway
    • ECS (or container-based deployment)
    • S3, EventBridge
    • CloudWatch
    • Secrets Manager / Parameter Store
  • Solid knowledge of REST API design and integration best practices.
  • Advanced PostgreSQL querying and optimization skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with data-heavy applications or analytics dashboards.
  • Familiarity with Athena or data pipeline integrations.
  • CI/CD experience with CodePipeline and/or Terraform.
  • Understanding of SCD Type 2 or other data lifecycle patterns.
